extracted.intended_audience: stakeholders and interested parties preparing and submitting public comments on an MSHA proposed rule (e.g., mine operators, equipment manufacturers, miners, safety advocates, legal representatives)
extracted.subtask_short: submitting comments on proposed MSHA rule
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and content requirements for submitting public comments to Docket No. MSHA-2025-0087 (RIN 1219-AB89) on the proposed rule regarding electronic surveying equipment in underground coal/gassy mines, including deadline, submission methods, and confidentiality guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comment submission deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: All comments must be submitted by midnight Eastern Standard Time on September 2, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This notice extends the previously scheduled close date (July 31, 2025) by an additional 30 days to allow stakeholders additional time to review and prepare comments. Ensure timestamp/time zone compliance when filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required identification (RIN or Docket number)
rubrics_metrics.description: All submissions must include RIN 1219-AB89 or Docket No. MSHA-2025-0087.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the RIN or docket identifier on every submission so it is associated with the correct rulemaking record; a brief summary of the document is available at the listed Regulations.gov docket.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid submitting personal or proprietary information
rubrics_metrics.description: You should not include personal or proprietary information that you do not wish to disclose publicly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MSHA will post comments publicly unless parts are marked as business confidential; exercise caution and exclude sensitive data from submissions whenever possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business confidential information marking
rubrics_metrics.description: If you mark parts of a comment as 'business confidential' information, MSHA will not post those parts of the comment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mark only the portions you assert are business confidential. Parts not so marked will be posted without change. Follow any additional agency guidance or FOIA-related procedures if withholding information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public posting policy for comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Otherwise, MSHA will post all comments without change, including any personal information provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assume submissions (except marked business confidential portions) will be publicly accessible and reproduced exactly in the docket; do not include information you do not want disclosed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted submission methods
rubrics_metrics.description: You may submit comments and informational materials by the Federal eRulemaking Portal (https://www.regulations.gov), Email (zzMSHA-comments@dol.gov), or Regular Mail/Hand Delivery to the MSHA Office address.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the online instructions on Regulations.gov for portal submissions. Clearly identify submissions by RIN or Docket Id. No telefacsimiles will be accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Email submission instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Include 'RIN 1219-AB89' in the subject line of the message when submitting comments by email to zzMSHA-comments@dol.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Placing the RIN in the subject line helps routing and docketing; still ensure the body of the message contains any required identification information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mail/Hand-delivery submission instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Regular Mail or Hand Delivery: MSHA, Office of Standards, Regulations, and Variances, Room C3522, 200 Constitution Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20210.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before visiting MSHA in person, call 202-693-9440 to make an appointment. Include the RIN or Docket number on mailed/hand-delivered submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: No telefacsimiles (faxes) accepted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not attempt to submit comments by fax; use one of the accepted methods listed above.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject matter context to guide comments
rubrics_metrics.description: The proposed rule would codify technical specifications and working conditions in MSHA standards to allow the use of electronic surveying equipment in underground gassy mines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comments should be focused on the substance of the proposed rule (technical specifications, working conditions, safety implications, feasibility, etc.) and reference the published proposed rule (90 FR 28454) as appropriate.
